hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; npx prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f"; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.cjs) npx eslint --fix --no-warn-ignored "$f";; esac; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

input=$(cat); [ "$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false')" = "true" ] && exit 0; [ -n "$(git status --porcelain -- '*.ts' '*.tsx' 2>/dev/null | head -1)" ] || exit 0; out=$(npm run typecheck 2>&1) || { printf 'npm run typecheck failed:\n%s\n' "$(printf '%s' "$out" | grep -E 'error TS|Error:' | head -40)" >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0
